hero.intro_en: In an interview you're asked: “Where do you see yourself in 5 years?” Write a clear career goals statement that shows ambition, initiative and a real connection to the company. It becomes part of your final Capstone.
hero.intro_es: En una entrevista te preguntan: “Where do you see yourself in 5 years?” Escribe una declaración de objetivos profesionales clara que muestre ambición, iniciativa y una conexión real con la empresa. Se convierte en parte de tu Capstone final.

hint.en: Your current role or field, in one sentence.
hint.es: Tu puesto o campo actual, en una oración.

parts.example: Today, I'm a logistics coordinator with six years of experience…
phrases: Today, I'm a [role] with [number] years of experience in [field].
I'm currently working as a [role], focused on [area].

hint.en: Where you see yourself in 5 years: specific and realistic.
hint.es: Dónde te ves en 5 años: concreto y realista.

parts.example: In five years, I see myself leading a regional operations team…
phrases: In five years, I see myself [goal].
My long-term goal is to become a [role] who [impact].
I'd like to grow into a role where I can [responsibility].

parts.en: How you plan to grow in the U.S. workplace
parts.es: Cómo planeas crecer en el trabajo en EE. UU.

hint.en: Skills, certifications, English, mentors: your concrete steps.
hint.es: Habilidades, certificaciones, inglés, mentores: tus pasos concretos.

parts.example: To get there, I plan to earn a supply chain certification…
phrases: To get there, I plan to [step].
In my first year, I want to [learn / earn / improve] [skill].

parts.en: The connection to the company's future
parts.es: La conexión con el futuro de la empresa

hint.en: Show how your growth helps the company grow.
hint.es: Muestra cómo tu crecimiento ayuda a que la empresa crezca.

parts.example: As your company expands into new markets, I want to help…
phrases: As [company] grows in [area], I want to help [result].
My goals match your plans to [company goal].
I see this role as a place to build a long-term career, not just a job.

hint.en: One sentence that sums up your commitment.
hint.es: Una oración que resuma tu compromiso.

parts.example: I'm ready to grow with your team and contribute from day one.
phrases: I'm ready to grow with your team and contribute from day one.
I'm excited about building my future here.

rules.d_en: Real goals and real steps, not dreams without a plan.
rules.d_es: Metas y pasos reales, no sueños sin plan.

rules.d_en: Show you want to grow here; never call the job a stepping stone.
rules.d_es: Muestra que quieres crecer aquí; nunca llames al trabajo un “trampolín”.

rules.d_en: First person, short paragraphs, no bullet points or emojis.
rules.d_es: En primera persona, párrafos cortos, sin viñetas ni emojis.

example.subject: Career Goals Statement – Ana Pérez
paragraphs: Today, I'm a logistics coordinator with six years of experience managing shipments between Mexico and the United States.
In five years, I see myself leading a regional operations team and helping a growing company deliver faster and more reliably.
To get there, I plan to earn a supply chain certification in my first two years and keep improving my business English, especially in presentations and negotiations.
I also want to find a mentor inside the company and learn how decisions are made across departments.
I know your company is expanding its cross-border services, and that is exactly where my experience can add value.
As your operations grow, I want to help build processes that are clear, efficient and easy for new team members to learn.
For me, this role is a place to build a long-term career, not just a job.
I'm ready to grow with your team and contribute from day one.

original.goal: Clear goals show ambition, initiative, and alignment with employer expectations.
original.title: Career Goals Statement
original.body_en:
✍️ Writing Task

Title: Career Goals Statement
Time: 1–2 hours

Scenario:
You're asked in an interview: "Where do you see yourself in 5 years?"

Your Task: Write a career goals statement (150–200 words) that:

Describes your professional objectives.

Explains how you plan to grow in the U.S. workplace.

Connects your goals to the company's future.

Why This Matters:
Clear goals show ambition, initiative, and alignment with employer expectations.
original.body_es:
✍️ Tarea de Escritura

Título: Declaración de Objetivos Profesionales
Tiempo: 1–2 horas

Escenario:
Te preguntan en una entrevista: "¿Dónde te ves en 5 años?"

Tu Tarea: Escribe una declaración de objetivos profesionales (150–200 palabras) que:

Describa tus objetivos profesionales.

Explique cómo planeas crecer en el entorno laboral de EE.UU.

Conecte tus metas con el futuro de la empresa.

Por Qué Esto Importa:
Tener objetivos claros demuestra ambición, iniciativa y alineación con las expectativas del empleador.
original.goal_es: Tener objetivos claros demuestra ambición, iniciativa y alineación con las expectativas del empleador.

scenario.en: You're in a job interview with a U.S. company, and the hiring manager asks you about your future.
scenario.es: Estás en una entrevista de trabajo con una empresa de EE. UU. y la gerente de contratación te pregunta por tu futuro.
scenario.quote: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
